name: Persona
tagline: Identity verification and KYC/KYB API for compliance workflows
description: Persona provides identity verification, KYC/KYB, and watchlist screening APIs for modern compliance workflows. Developers use it to verify individuals and businesses, run risk checks, and manage verification sessions programmatically.

auth.details: API key via Authorization Bearer header (self-serve signup)

use_cases: create identity verification inquiry for a user
retrieve inquiry status and verification results
